recommendation_summary: The reply recommends one hosted dead-man's-switch monitor outside the home: `nightly-sync` sends start, success and failure signals, and the monitor alerts the user by phone push (with email as backup) if success doesn't arrive by a daily deadline. It also says to test that a failed run and a skipped run both raise an alert.
note: There is one heartbeat alert. Docker on the Synology is mentioned only as a caveated option, central logging is put off until troubleshooting gets painful, and none of the four labelled lines appear.
